(2024)'s fit to NICER X-ray pulse profiles of 2017 to 2021: 2 regions built from circles, 0.53 million K to 1.58 million K, covering 4.9% of the surface. (2026), arXiv:2605.05429, Table 1 measure from Hubble far-ultraviolet and ROSAT soft X-ray spectra, fitted without hot regions for the surface outside the hot regions.
